phases.name: Phase 1: Critical fixes in Hoststar Designer

redesign_assessment.verdict: Yes — rebuild justified for capability reasons, not aesthetics
redesign_assessment.rationale: Roughly 40 of the missing 66 health-score points are locked behind the BaseKit platform (schema, image pipeline, reservation widget, robots control, og:images, security headers). Strong off-site reputation (4.4-4.8 stars) is not being converted: no online reservation, no booking path, no review proof, SERP title 'Startseite'.
redesign_assessment.interim: Do in-platform quick wins first (~3h, lifts score to ~45-50)
